A.rationale: Strength: systematic per-channel red-teaming with fully verbatim primary-source grounding (Fed/NBER/FRBSF/EIA) at every node and a clean time-varying supply-vs-demand synthesis. Weakness: slightly narrower distinct-angle set (no FTPL steelman or explicit Fed-role-in-disinflation line) and no dead-ends/unverified-quote accounting.

B.rationale: Strength: broadest distinct-angle set (adds FTPL steelman, monetarism, and a full disinflation-attribution line on who pulled inflation down) with explicit dead-ends and honest flagging of unverified quotes. Weakness: several load-bearing quotes (Ferguson-Storm, Krugman) admittedly not re-verified, and energy is treated thinly.

A.rationale: Strength: exceptionally broad channel-plus-meta coverage (adds central-bank self-assessment and an insider/outsider red-team) anchored by a crisp measure-decides-the-sign synthesis and a 2025 identification-frontier paper. Weakness: aging/r* links and a few key studies are search-surfaced or via media summaries rather than primary-read (self-admitted).

B.rationale: Strength: clean primary-source grounding (US DFA data apt for 2020-21) with a double red-team that even red-teams its own BoE rebuttal, and a sharp direction-vs-magnitude synthesis. Weakness: one fewer distinct meta-angle than its pair and no dead-ends/retired-hypothesis accounting.

A.rationale: Strength: the two-observationally-equivalent-hypotheses framing (near-neutral vs lagged) plus dual red-teams of both over- and under-estimation directly serve the causal-identification core. Weakness: narrower evidence base (no clean freelance quasi-experiment), reliance on a secondary tracker for agent-reliability figures, and leaked internal cross-references.

B.rationale: Strength: broadest, best-integrated coverage including the cleanest causal design (freelance quasi-experiment) and an explicit quantified posterior (~55-60% lagged) with documented dead-ends. Weakness: many load-bearing quotes come via reputable secondary restatements (Fortune/Brookings/Gazette) rather than primary sources.

A.rationale: Strength: adds the non-obvious per-working-age 'lost decades overstated' reframe that reframes the whole question, plus explicit probability calibration (base/tail/upside) and a steelmanned bear case held as a live tail risk. Weakness: several load-bearing numbers are self-admittedly search-summarized rather than verbatim-extracted.

B.rationale: Strength: granular, mostly-verbatim quantification of the demographic drag, robot-density comparators and debt/ICOR across the core channels with solid per-line red-teaming. Weakness: lacks the per-working-age reframe and explicit probability calibration, leans on a weak substack source, and one line (effective-labor offset) is essentially unevidenced.

A.rationale: Strength: broad reconciliation across four margins including firm-exit selection (Yelp) and the CA fast-food $20 frontier from both sides, with an extensive dedicated red-team block. Weakness: a load-bearing Seattle-reconciliation quote uses a non-specific Berkeley URL, and there is no dead-ends/error-correction accounting.

B.rationale: Strength: sharpest reconciliation of the core tension (sign-not-magnitude) with precise elasticities (Azar concentration sign-flip, Dube-Lindner meta OWE -0.13) grounded in primary PDFs and documented error-corrections. Weakness: folds distribution/firm-exit into the conclusion rather than pursuing it as a distinct line, and covers the CA20 frontier more thinly than its pair.
